//: Every place outside pom.xml that names the PUBLISHED EDDI release a reader should deploy:
the Helm appVersion, the k8s manifests, and the copy-pasteable commands in the docs.
One definition, two readers. scripts/bump-version.py rewrites every match to the new
release; ReleaseVersionSourceTest fails the build unless every match names the same
version as helm/eddi/Chart.yaml's appVersion. A new doc that writes labsai/eddi:<x.y.z>
is picked up by both without anyone having to remember to list it. The walk and the
matching are implemented twice (Python and Java); BumpVersionScriptTest checks that the
roots: files, or directories walked recursively. extensions: only these files are read.
exclude: PATH PREFIXES relative to the repository root, '/'-separated: a file, a
directory ending in '/', or a family such as 'docs/release-notes-'.
patterns: matched one LINE at a time; the FIRST capture group is the version. Keep them
to the syntax Java and Python share: no named groups, no possessive quantifiers, no ^ or
$ anchors, ASCII classes only. Each ends in (?![\w-]|\.\d), which lets a sentence's
full stop follow the version but refuses 6.3.0-RC1, 6.3.0-b42 and 6.3.0.1.
The exclusions are history (the changelog, the archive, per-release notes) and
release-versioning.md, whose version numbers are worked examples of the tagging scheme.
